_doc: Two-sided regression gate for `run_oracle.py --selftest` (--skip-docker, partial denominators). Adversarial workspaces must stay AT OR BELOW max_partial_pct and their must_fail ids must fail by DETECTION (a crash does not count). The positive control must stay AT OR ABOVE min_partial_pct with every must_pass id PASS. Ceilings = observed + 2 so silent inflation of even one weight-1 check trips the gate.

positive_control.why: known-good three-service Gradle+compose project; P3 is NOT_ATTEMPTED here (no runner manifest) and 100% is asserted by the full-oracle run in the README

cheatE_stubs_no_java.why: 11 stub files, zero Java - scored 100% via inapplicable-exclusion

cheatA_comment_only.why: one Java file containing only a comment mentioning BigDecimal

cheatB_bugs_in_test_pkg.why: buggy files moved to a package named test to dodge the /test/ skip

cheatC_renamed_fields.why: price->px, balance->bal to dodge name regex

cheatD_dir_named_java.why: empty directory named Broken.java crashed the checker and dropped the suite

cheatF_prebuilt_jar._note: R5 C-1/C-2: a committed jar COPYd into the image; offline only S4/S5 are scored (50 %, ceiling observed+2); the docker block (C2 must FAIL with 'host-built artefact') is evaluated by --selftest --with-docker
